name: ops-board
description: One answer to 'status?': a pane, /ops-status and a status line with agents, background tasks, your open PRs with CI verdicts, and lane health. A paralel lane that is silent or dead gets one check turn and one restart turn in its coordinator session, then a decision record in ~/.claude/autonomy/decisions.json; no turn while ~/.claude/autonomy.off exists.

silent_minutes.title: Silent lane limit (minutes)
silent_minutes.description: A lane whose ledger state is running and that shows no activity for this many minutes is silent: ops-board asks the coordinator for one check, then one restart.
